An '''epaulet''' was a type of ornamental shoulder piece worn by military personnel. [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]] of the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] wore spiked epaulets as a symbol of his military authority.

The [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admirals]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] sometimes wore [[Color/Legends|gold]] epaulets as part of their [[Grand Admiral's uniform/Legends|uniform]].
